title: Split-screen player HUD placement and rider tags
summary: Anchor and rotate the shared toolbar into player 1’s view, and show the other local riders through colored per-view name, distance and direction tags.
details: Toolbar touch hit coordinates follow the same view transform as its rendering. Local rider tags reuse the existing peer projector for each player view. This is an authored split-screen usability adaptation; it does not establish original-game fidelity.
limitation: CI and the focused split-facing browser test are pending. Physical phones remain unverified. No screenshots have been captured or attached to this checkpoint.
